text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*... *haa*... I fell just one step 
short...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I gave it everything, and it felt so good, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. You're right, the 
results aren't bad at all...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
All right, gotta reset my mindset! I'll 
get stronger and win next time!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"...Yes! I'll use this frustration as fuel 
and give it my all in training again!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
And so, next time I'll definitely take 
first place! Trainer, please keep your 
eyes on me!
